/* file : DTSimulationMapper.xml, id : getSimulationSetModelList */ SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(A.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T') as reg_dt_str , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM TB_CODE_DTL T WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.GRP_CD = 'STATUS' AND T.DTL_CD = A.MODEL_STATUS) STATUS_NM , (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.USER_SEQ = A.REG_USER_SEQ) USER_ID FROM TB_META_MODEL A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_META_USER_ITEM B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND 1=1
AND UPPER(A.MODEL_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{modelNm}), '%')
AND A.JOB_LEVEL = 'M' AND A.MODEL_STATUS = 'DONE'
AND A.DATA_USE_TP = 'F'
AND A.DATA_USE_TP != 'F'
AND A.JOB_LEVEL = 'P'
ORDER BY REG_DT DESC

/* file : DTSimulationMapper.xml, id : getDTSimulationLogList */ SELECT A.* , B.FILE_NM , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM TB_CODE_DTL T WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.GRP_CD = 'AUGMENT_STATUS' AND T.DTL_CD = A.AUGMENT_STATUS) AUGMENT_STATUS_NM FROM TB_META_AUGMENT_LOG A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_META_AUGMENT_FILES B ON A.FILE_SEQ = B.FILE_SEQ WHERE A.AUGMENT_SEQ = #{augment_seq} ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC
/* file : DTSimulationMapper.xml, id : getModelFiles */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_MODEL_FILES WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND REF_TP = 'MODEL' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT CONCAT(B.FILE_PATH, '/', B.FILE_NM) AUGMENT_FILE_PATH, FILE_SEQ AUGMENT_FILE_SEQ FROM TB_META_AUGMENT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_META_AUGMENT_FILES B ON A.AUGMENT_SEQ = B.AUGMENT_SEQ AND B.REF_TP = 'CYCLE' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.AUGMENT_SEQ = #{augmentSeq};
SELECT DISTINCT MODEL_COL_NM FROM TB_META_MODEL_COLUMN WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS result FROM TB_META_AUGMENT WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} AND AUGMENT_TP = 'R';
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS result FROM TB_META_AUGMENT WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} AND AUGMENT_TP = 'R' AND AUGMENT_STATUS = 'T';
UPDATE TB_META_AUGMENT SET USE_YN= 'N', DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_USER_SEQ = #{user_seq}, DEL_DT = now(), DEL_IP = #{user_ip} WHERE AUGMENT_SEQ = #{augment_seq}
